newsitem.title: USA: Palmer says objections to Price deal without merit.
newsitem.headline: Palmer says objections to Price deal without merit.

text.p: Palmer Wireless Inc said Monday that objections to its agreement to be acquired by Price Communications Corp are "without merit."
It said objections were raised in an informal comment filed with the Federal Communications Commission on July 21. It did not name the party that made the filing.

"The company's counsel strongly believes that the arguments raised in the filing are without merit, and management still anticipates closing the transaction during the fourth quarter of this year," Palmer said in a press release.
Palmer officials were not available for comment.
Price announced on May 23 a definitive agreement to acquire Palmer for $17.50 cash per share, or a total of $880 million, including repayment of debt. The deal is subject to regulatory approval.
